summary: Remote-controlled shell and filesystem access over WebSocket in @yeaft/webchat-agent
details: The package runs as an agent that connects outbound to a configured WebSocket server and dispatches remote messages into local host actions. `terminal_create` and `terminal_input` messages spawn a PTY (bash/powershell) and write remote-supplied bytes directly into it (term.pty.write(msg.data)), giving whoever controls the server plus AGENT_SECRET an interactive shell on the host. The same message router also handles `read_file`, `write_file`, `create_file`, `delete_files`, `git_commit`, `git_push`, and `upgrade_agent`; the upgrade path runs `npm install -g <pkg>@latest` and restarts the systemd/launchd/PM2 unit, allowing the server to push and execute new code on the host. Modification of PATH in service/linux.js is part of the installed service setup. Any party with the WebSocket URL and shared secret obtains persistent full-host RCE, filesystem read/write, git repo control, and remote self-upgrade over the running agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
